messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····, email (email hidden)

Nothing's changed since we spoke, Gerald. Shop···· is paid and still unshipped at the warehouse, waiting on the end-of-October batch of the Airsquitter (4DSKY), so it ships October 31. Your Harlo OS Diagnostics goes out in the same box.

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking lands in this email as soon as it leaves. Anything else I can check for you?

Yes, I realized after the order was placed that I had typed in my e-mail address incorrectly. It is actually: (email hidden) instead of (email hidden)  I left out the first 'a' when I placed the order. All of the other information is correct. Can you please edit and update my e-mail address?
Handed to the team · Email address change on an order is not something I change myself; passing it to

Thanks for catching that. Changing the email on an order isn't something I do from here, so I've passed it to the team with both addresses, and one of them will jump into this chat shortly. If you step away, you'll get the confirmation by email.

Until it's updated, order notices and the tracking for October 31 will still go to (email hidden), so keep an eye on that inbox in the meantime.
Before you go, one thing: what made you go with the Airsquitter over the other receivers out there?
I heard about the 4DSKY program through watching interviews with Neuron CEO, and I then wanted to take part in the building of the network.
That's a good reason to be in it. What made October the moment to actually order, rather than earlier when you first heard about it?
Waiting on my purchase of this house to be finalized, which occurred in late August.
Congratulations on the house. Last one: now that you have the site, is the 4DSKY the only thing you're putting up there, or are you looking at adding anything alongside it?
Understood, thanks for telling me. The team will confirm the email change here or by email, and your tracking follows on October 31.
